tree.heading: Eligibility.—
tree.text: Except as provided in this chapter, eligibility for membership in the corporation and the rights and privileges of members are as provided in the constitution and bylaws.

tree.heading: Nondiscrimination.—
tree.text: The terms of membership may not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, or national origin.
